text:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (prod, us-west-2). p95 -> 1.2s (SLO 0.8s), p99 -> 4.8s (SLO 2.0s). Streaming stalls observed; prefix-cache hit rate dropped from ~92% -> 18% in the last 20m. No increase in 5xxs. Rolling prefixhash rollout applied 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC yesterday.

devon: I'm oncall, jumping in.

chao: Looking at runtime KPIs — tail is high, KV-store miss rate spiked. Paging writebacks increased ~3x. My hunch: prefixhash bucketization change moved hot prefixes into cold buckets.

mira: Adding telemetry: per-shard prefix hit rates for the last 30m: shard-3=6%, shard-7=12%, shard-0=88%. Cold shards align with paging surge.

elaine: Support: two enterprise customers flagged stream timeouts and slow demos in the past 15m. Tracking as high-priority.

ben: CSM here — confirmed. One demo dropped. Need mitigation and customer comms.

devon: Plan: 1) route 15% traffic to fallback pool (no prefixcache) 2) run targeted prefetch on top prefixes 3) prepare rollback for the prefixhash change if needed. Chao/Sam own 2/1 respectively. Mira you'll oversee SLO checks.

chao: Kicking off prefetch for top prefixes. Command: `./infra/tools/prefetch --env prod --shards 0-11 --top 5000 --concurrency 20`

ops-bot: Prefetch command queued on 12 workers, estimate start in ~2m.

mira: While warming runs, we should flip a temporary routing rule. Sam can you create the canary to route 15% -> fallback_pool?

sam: I can. Preparing routing change: `traffic_split: { prefix_pool: 85, fallback_pool: 15 }`. Will push in ~2m.

devon: Also enable debug prefixcache tracing on shard-3 so we can capture prefixhash diffs and kvstats. Chao please grab snapshots.

chao: Snapshot saved: s3://redwood-ops/triage/2394202468/prefix_snapshot.json.gz. KV miss sample: 2026/10000 in 15m. Small log sample:
```
[INFO] shard=3 key="usr:1234:hist" hash_old=0x1a2b3c hash_new=0x9f88a0 bucket_old=42 bucket_new=7
[WARN] prefix="usr:" misses increased 12x
```

elaine: Noted. Affected customers were routed through shard-3. Support has offered temporary timeout increases to 10s and notified account owners.

ben: I'll follow up with customer success and coordinate compensation if required.

mira: If prefetch + routing drops p95 under SLO within 10–15m we can avoid rollback. Let's set a 15m evaluation window.

devon: I'm creating a rollback PR (revert commit `abc123`) and holding approval for now. If metrics don't improve I'll merge and rollout.

sam: Canary applied at 2394202560 — fallback_pool now receiving 15% traffic.

ops-bot: Prefetch workers started at 2394202580. ETA complete ~2394202820.

incident-bot: Update: p95 -> 0.95s, p99 -> 2.9s, aggregated prefix-cache hit rate -> 43% (up ~25pp). Trending down on stalls.

chao: Prefetch finished for top 5k prefixes. Shard-3 hit rate rose 6% -> 54% after warming.

mira: Streaming stall count fell from 120 -> 12 in the last 6m. This is trending healthy.

devon: Given improvement, hold off rollback. Continue monitoring for 30m. Chao capture prefixhash mapping diff for postmortem.

chao: Diff uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/triage/2394202468/prefixhash_diff.txt. TL;DR: bucket_count reduced from 128 -> 64 in rollout, causing modular reduction shifts that moved many hot prefixes into previously cold buckets (edge-case due to non-uniform key distribution).

elaine: Support notes: tickets updated, customers offered mitigation steps + summary. Drafting a customer-facing explanation. Will attach timeline once postmortem is ready.

ben: Scheduling follow-ups with affected accounts, and offering a technical debrief.

mira: Postmortem checklist I'm adding: timeline, root cause (prefixhash modulo change), immediate mitigation (prefetch + routing canary), short-term fixes (graceful bucket migration), long-term (rollout canary with hit-rate gate, automated warmup).

sam: Action item: introduce a per-shard hit-rate gate in rollout pipeline (reject if delta > 5%). Also add synthetic warmup job to run automatically post-rollout for top-k prefixes.

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated; state set to monitoring. Channel created: #incident-2394202468. Automated close scheduled if stable for 2h.

devon: I'll remain on-call through monitoring window and run the war room at 16:00 UTC for debrief. If anything regresses I'll escalate to infra leads.

incident-bot: Log: incident 2394202468 mitigated at 2394203260. p99 settled ~1.8s.

devon: Thanks everyone. Leaving the channel open for any late regressions. :thumbsup:
